summary: This is a Form 6-K filing by Vipshop Holdings Ltd, a foreign private issuer, reporting its unaudited financial results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2026. The filing contains routine quarterly earnings disclosure with no mention of any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The registrant's role is that of an issuer filing a standard earnings report.
